name: ConcordiaPax / Quarters2Crypto Design Tokens
description: Shared brand tokens for injecting ConcordiaPax and Q2C tone into websites, apps, and AI-assisted design tools.

heading.usage: Headlines, section titles, CTA labels, strong interface moments

body.usage: Editorial body copy, long-form sections, explanatory content

mono.usage: Eyebrows, metadata, labels, technical callouts, small UI text

layout_guidance.hero: Keep the current cinematic background image or use a photo/illustration with strong atmosphere. Overlay with dark slate gradients and restrained warm glows.
layout_guidance.sections: Prefer spacious editorial blocks, clean card grids, and narrow readable body copy over crowded dashboards.
layout_guidance.buttons: Use gold/bronze fills for primary CTA. Use transparent gold-outline treatments for secondary CTA.
layout_guidance.highlights: Use gold for emphasis, muted violet for depth, and teal sparingly for signal or technical accents.

prompt_snippet: Use a dark editorial layout with Space Grotesk headings, Source Serif 4 body text, and IBM Plex Mono labels. Keep the palette grounded: slate-black backgrounds, warm gold highlights, bronze accents, muted smoky violet depth, and small teal technical accents. Avoid neon pink banners or loud crypto clichés. The tone should feel practical, intelligent, and trust-first.
